description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Ringing into force Throughout Sri Lanka from August 30 2021
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the parliamentary approval of a Proclamation made by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, bringing Emergency Regulations into force. The content deals specifically with the legal framework for emergency measures (supply of essential food items) and the statutory process for implementing them under an existing ordinance. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it concerns the implementation of regulations and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes or organizational structure.
